summary: Stripe Live Integration feature testing completed. Backend APIs (14 tests) and frontend UI tests all pass. Stripe requires API key with sk_ prefix - client-side and backend validation working correctly. Non-Stripe platforms (HubSpot, Shopify, Salesforce, QuickBooks) use mock data and connect without API key. Summary cards appear when platforms are connected.

issues: Console warning about negative chart width/height - existing Recharts library issue when container is not visible (pre-existing)

backend_api_tests: Stripe connect without API key returns 400
Stripe connect with empty API key returns 400
Stripe connect with invalid key returns 400
Stripe connect with non-sk_ prefix format rejected
HubSpot connect no API key required (mock) - returns is_live=false
Shopify connect no API key required (mock) - returns is_live=false
Salesforce connect no API key required (mock) - returns is_live=false
QuickBooks connect no API key required (mock) - returns is_live=false
Disconnect mock platform works and removes synced data
Summary with mock connections returns correct data
frontend_ui_tests: Live Integration page loads with all 5 platforms
Stripe card shows 'Connect with API Key' button with Key icon
Other platform cards show plain 'Connect' button with arrow icon
Stripe modal opens on click with correct elements
Stripe modal has: password input, security notice, Dashboard link, Cancel/Connect buttons
Empty key - Connect button is disabled (correct behavior)
Invalid key format (no sk_ prefix) shows client-side toast: 'API key must start with sk_test_ or sk_live_'
Invalid sk_test_ key shows backend error toast: 'Connection failed'
HubSpot connect (mock) shows success toast: 'Connected HubSpot. X records synced.'
Re-sync and Disconnect buttons appear for connected platform
Re-sync button works - shows toast: 'Synced X records from HubSpot.'
Disconnect button works - shows toast: 'Platform disconnected'
After disconnect, platform shows Connect button again
Summary cards appear when platform connected (Platforms Connected, Records Synced, Total Pipeline Value, Data Sources Active)

critical_code_review_comments: Stripe API key stored in plain text in MongoDB (api_key_encrypted field) - should be encrypted in production
NOTE: Real Stripe API key required to test live data fetching - test key 'sk_test_emergent' correctly fails validation
seed_data_creation: Fresh test users created for backend API tests (stripe_test_*, bizconnect_test_*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe Live Integration feature complete. Stripe requires real API key (sk_test_* or sk_live_*) from dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys. The test key 'sk_test_emergent' in .env is for Stripe payments system, NOT for data fetching. Non-Stripe platforms (HubSpot, Shopify, Salesforce, QuickBooks) use MOCKED data. Connected Stripe shows 'Live' badge, others show 'Demo' badge. Backend validates key by calling stripe.accounts.retrieve('me'). Key stored in api_key_encrypted field (not actually encrypted - security note).

mocked_api.status: Shopify, HubSpot, Salesforce, QuickBooks integrations are MOCKED. Stripe is LIVE (requires real API key).
